name: ActiveCampaign
description: An "autonomous marketing platform" where AI agents handle email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more, backed by customer data; serves more than 180,000 businesses.
best_for: Positioned for growing businesses of any size that want to automate marketing/sales work (email, SMS, WhatsApp, CRM) and reduce manual effort; the mobile app targets sales/CRM users managing deals and contacts on the go.
features: Active Intelligence AI (brand-aware AI trained on top campaigns)
Email marketing with automation flows and newsletters
Visual automation builder with custom rules
1,000+ app integrations; mobile app for CRM/deal management

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Starting price for accounts with fewer than 1,000 contacts. ActiveCampaign pricing scales with contact volume and feature needs.

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses wanting an easy-to-use email/SMS marketing tool.

alternatives.name: Klaviyo
alternatives.description: An AI marketing and service platform built as an autonomous B2C CRM unifying customer data with omnichannel automation.
alternatives.best_for: Consumer/B2C brands, especially e-commerce retailers, wanting unified customer data and marketing.
